SELECT fsr.fba_shipment_id as businessCode, fsr.sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN fsr.receive_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd') - INTERVAL '1 month') AND DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd')) > fsr.receive_date THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fsr.receive_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd')) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fsr.receive_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd')) THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd')) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', fsr.receive_date) AND fsr.receive_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asCurrentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(${params.month}, 'YYYY-MM-dd') - INTERVAL '1 month') >= DATE_TRUNC('month', fsr.receive_date) AND fsr.receive_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asLastMonthReceiveQty FROM fba_shipment_receive fsr WHERE fsr.is_deleted = FALSE
and fsr.fba_shipment_id in
#{item}
GROUP BY businessCode,fsr.sku_id
